SELECT SUM(appointmentRegister) AS appointmentRegister, SUM(appointmentRegisterLast) AS appointmentRegisterLast, SUM(todayRegister) AS todayRegister, SUM(todayRegisterLast) AS todayRegisterLast, SUM(appointmentFetch) AS appointmentFetch, SUM(appointmentFetchLast) AS appointmentFetchLast, SUM(refund) AS refund, SUM(refundLast) AS refundLast FROM ( SELECT , 0 AS appointmentRegisterLast, 0 AS todayRegisterLast, 0 AS appointmentFetchLast, 0 AS refund, 0 AS refundLast FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR IN (1, 2) AND c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS appointmentRegister, 0 AS todayRegister, 0 AS appointmentFetch, , 0 AS refund, 0 AS refundLast FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR IN (1, 2) AND c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS appointmentRegister, 0 AS todayRegister, 0 AS appointmentFetch, 0 AS appointmentRegisterLast, 0 AS todayRegisterLast, 0 AS appointmentFetchLast, , 0 AS refundLast FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS appointmentRegister, 0 AS todayRegister, 0 AS appointmentFetch, 0 AS appointmentRegisterLast, 0 AS todayRegisterLast, 0 AS appointmentFetchLast, 0 AS refund,
FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} )

SELECT SUM(outpatientCharge) AS outpatientCharge, SUM(outpatientRefund) AS outpatientRefund, SUM(outpatientChargeLast) AS outpatientChargeLast, SUM(outpatientRefundLast) AS outpatientRefundLast FROM ( SELECT , 0 AS outpatientChargeLast, 0 AS outpatientRefundLast FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS outpatientCharge, 0 AS outpatientRefund,
FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} )

SELECT SUM(prepayment) AS prepayment, SUM(hospitalRefund) AS hospitalRefund, SUM(prepaymentLast) AS prepaymentLast, SUM(hospitalRefundLast) AS hospitalRefundLast FROM ( SELECT , 0 AS prepaymentLast, 0 AS hospitalRefundLast FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS prepayment, 0 AS hospitalRefund,
FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} )

SELECT SUM(dischargeSettlement) AS dischargeSettlement, SUM(dischargeSettlementLast) AS dischargeSettlementLast FROM ( SELECT , 0 AS dischargeSettlementLast FROM tr_disch_settle_visit v WHERE v.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION ALL SELECT 0 AS dischargeSettlement,
FROM tr_disch_settle_visit v WHERE v.stat_date BETWEEN #{lastStartDate} AND #{lastEndDate} )

choose.when: SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND (c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 1 OR (c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE))) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) = TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) AND c.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT c.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS != 0 AND c.RETURNED_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND c.RETURNED_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY c.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 AND r.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND r.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT r.OPERATOR_NO AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0 AND r.STAT_DATE >= #{chartStartDate} AND r.STAT_DATE < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY r.OPERATOR_NO ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT p.operator_no AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.transact_type = '交款' AND p.stat_date >= #{chartStartDate} AND p.stat_date < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY p.operator_no ORDER BY itemValue DESC

SELECT p.operator_no AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.transact_type = '退款' AND p.stat_date >= #{chartStartDate} AND p.stat_date < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY p.operator_no ORDER BY itemValue DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT m.operator_no AS cashierName, COUNT(1) AS itemValue FROM tr_settle_master m WHERE m.stat_date >= #{chartStartDate} AND m.stat_date < #{chartEndDate} GROUP BY m.operator_no ORDER BY itemValue DESC

mapper.select:
SELECT period AS "period", dim AS "dim", metric AS "metric", SUM(cnt) AS "cnt" FROM ( SELECT a.period AS period, a.dim AS dim, mm.metric AS metric, CASE mm.metric WHEN '预约挂号量' THEN a.yy_cnt WHEN '预约取号量' THEN a.qh_cnt ELSE a.dr_cnt END AS cnt FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 1 OR TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS yy_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) != TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qh_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND TRUNC(c.VISIT_DATE) = TRUNC(c.REGISTERING_DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dr_cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR IN (1, 2) AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE != -1
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.STAT_DATE) ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '预约挂号量' AS metric FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '预约取号量' FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '当日挂号量' FROM DUAL ) mm UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE) AS period, '退号量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.RETURNED_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND c.APPOINTS_INDICATOR = 2 AND c.IS_RETURN_TYPE = -1 AND c.REGISTRATION_STATUS <> 0
GROUP BY TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(c.RETURNED_DATE) UNION ALL SELECT a.period AS period, a.dim AS dim, mm.metric AS metric, CASE mm.metric WHEN '门诊收费量' THEN a.jf_cnt ELSE a.tf_cnt END AS cnt FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jf_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tf_cnt FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_RCPT_ACCT r WHERE r.STAT_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND (NVL(r.TOTAL_CHARGES, 0) >= 0 OR (r.REFUNDED_RCPT_NO IS NOT NULL AND r.TOTAL_CHARGES < 0))
GROUP BY TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE, 'MM')TRUNC(r.STAT_DATE) ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '门诊收费量' AS metric FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '门诊退费量' FROM DUAL ) mm UNION ALL SELECT a.period AS period, a.dim AS dim, mm.metric AS metric, CASE mm.metric WHEN '收预交金量' THEN a.jk_cnt ELSE a.tk_cnt END AS cnt FROM ( SELECT TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) AS period, SUM(CASE WHEN p.transact_type = '交款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jk_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN p.transact_type = '退款' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tk_cnt FROM tr_inpat_prepay_rcpt p WHERE p.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.transact_type IN ('交款', '退款')
GROUP BY TRUNC(p.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(p.stat_date) ) a CROSS JOIN ( SELECT '收预交金量' AS metric FROM DUAL UNION ALL SELECT '退院量' FROM DUAL ) mm UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(m.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(m.stat_date) AS period, '出院结算量' AS metric, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tr_settle_master m WHERE m.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
GROUP BY TRUNC(m.stat_date, 'MM')TRUNC(m.stat_date) ) GROUP BY period, dim, metric HAVING SUM(cnt) > 0 ORDER BY period, dim, metric
